subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful embedded `after_compaction` hooks gain the permanent current-session-only `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` plugin contract proposed here?
rationale: This is a new session-mutating plugin capability whose permanent availability, result semantics, and supported compaction paths require owner intent even if the implementation defects are repaired.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Keep the current-session-only, deferred, successful-compaction-only API after the import boundary and real-runtime proof are fixed.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Remove the public hook API and expose a narrower owner-specific compaction recovery seam instead.

options.title: Pause the capability
options.body: Close or defer the PR until a broader plugin session-lifecycle design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Keep the current-session-only, deferred, successful-compaction-only API after the import boundary and real-runtime proof are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the related compaction/reset hook surface and are the clearest available contract-history owner.
